precision: Numbers rounded to .001; interval inclusion used full precision. Dense unrounded traces and full geometry proof remain in the referenced baseline/census.

definitions.quiet: Only actual substantive normalSpeed>=.6/velocityChange>=.35 impacts or power change>.35 reset the interval; foliage/sap excluded; nearby surfaces never reset it.
definitions.clearance: GJK against actual compound8-vertex species fixtures and canonical triangulated/edge/circle fixtures, including solver polygon skins at the build scale. Nearby lists derive from exact quarter/mid/three-quarter checkpoints, then dense-sampled interior minima for their union; they are not a global continuous minimum over every map object. Interior minima trim0.1s from each endpoint (or10% for shorter intervals); observed first-pre-solve records use only0.01s trim. This explains near-boundary quiet touches that are absent from interior clearance minima.
definitions.sweeps: TimeOfImpact on adjacent dense sampled poses around each near-geometry minimum; an interpolated sweep inference, not a substitute for recorded solver contacts. All authored solid contacts were tracked during the actual run; bare ground has substantive events/support flags but was not in the tracked-object callback.
definitions.bounds: Trajectory bounds are the observed body-origin centre path; clearances use all compound fixtures. Terminal calm support is labeled separately but does not remove any>1s interval.
